# File Placement and Naming

## Placement Rules

| Content Type | Location |
|---|---|
| Raw scans, transcripts, chat exports | `00-Inbox/` |
| Cleaned handwritten, transcripts, rough notes | `01-Source/` |
| Weekly synthesis bundles | `02-Intake/Weekly/YYYY-WW/` |
| Weekly indices | `02-Intake/Index/` |
| Learning Journal Step outputs | `03-Working/Step-[N]-<Name>/` |
| Book part drafts | `04-Book/Part-0N-<Name>/` |
| Diagrams | `05-Assets/Diagrams/` |
| Circuits | `05-Assets/Circuits/` |
| Readings | `05-Assets/Readings/` |
| Templates | `05-Assets/Templates/` |
| Terms, definitions, phrases | `06-Lexicon/` |
| Guides and orientation docs | `07-Guides/` |
| Plans, instructions, logs, indices | `08-Admin/` |

## Naming Conventions

- Dated notes: `YYYY-MM-DD-<short-descriptor>.md`
- Weekly folders: `YYYY-WW`
- Chat exports: `YYYY-WW-Chat-Export/`
- Keep filenames stable once cited in drafts

## Rules

- End every file-ready output with a **Proposed Save Location**
- If placement is uncertain, propose two plausible locations and ask
- Never invent file moves outside the established folder structure
- Never create new top-level folders without explicit approval
